name: divorce-doc-drafter
description: PRC divorce litigation document skill bundling full marriage-family statutes and SPC judicial interpretations. Persona of a seasoned Chinese divorce litigation counsel. Covers drafting and revising element-style civil complaints (民事起诉状·离婚纠纷) and civil answers (民事答辩状·离婚纠纷), with precise citation of the Civil Code Marriage-and-Family Book (arts.1040-1118) and SPC interpretations (一/二). Use when drafting, reviewing, or revising divorce litigation documents, or citing marriage-family law.
